extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, and interested parties wishing to submit or review comments on the FAA petition for exemption (Docket FAA-2022-0841)
extracted.subtask_description: Submitting and accessing public comments and the petition summary for an FAA petition for exemption (Docket FAA-2022-0841); includes deadlines, submission methods, privacy/posting rules, and where to find official documents. The page is a single Federal Register notice summarizing a petition and giving procedural guidance for commenting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timely and docket-identified comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments on this petition must identify the petition docket number and must be received on or before June 2, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments must identify the petition docket number (FAA-2022-0841) and be received by the closing date; see the DATES section for the deadline. "Comments Close 06/02/2025".

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods for submitting comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Send comments identified by docket number FAA-2022-0841 using any of the following methods: Federal eRulemaking Portal (https://www.regulations.gov), Mail, Hand Delivery or Courier, Fax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Online: Go to https://www.regulations.gov and follow the online instructions for sending your comments electronically. Mail: Docket Operations, M-30; U.S. Department of Transportation, 1200 New Jersey Avenue SE, Room W12-140, West Building Ground Floor, Washington, DC 20590-0001. Hand Delivery/Courier: same physical address, between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday–Friday (except Federal holidays). Fax: (202) 493-2251.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and public posting of comments
rubrics_metrics.description: In accordance with 5 U.S.C. 553(c), DOT solicits comments from the public to better inform its rulemaking process. DOT posts these comments, without edit, including any personal information the commenter provides, to https://www.regulations.gov, as described in the system of records notice (DOT/ALL-14 FDMS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume confidentiality: comments (including any personal information provided) will be posted without edit to Regulations.gov per DOT/ALL-14 FDMS. See DOT privacy notice at https://www.dot.gov/​privacy for more details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency review, redaction, and posting delay
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies review all submissions and may choose to redact, or withhold, certain submissions (or portions thereof). Submitted comments may not be available to be read until the agency has approved them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even though comments are solicited and will be posted, agencies reserve the right to redact or withhold content and there may be a delay before a submitted comment appears publicly while awaiting agency approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket access and availability of background documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Background documents or comments received may be read at https://www.regulations.gov at any time. Follow the online instructions for accessing the docket or go to the Docket Operations in Room W12-140 of the West Building Ground Floor at 1200 New Jersey Avenue SE, Washington, DC 20590-0001, between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can access the docket and supporting materials online at Regulations.gov or in-person at the DOT Docket Operations office during business hours; follow the site instructions to find specific documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official electronic format and verification
rubrics_metrics.description: This document has been published in the Federal Register. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format. The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov is a prototype and does not provide legal notice until the Administrative Committee of the Federal Register (ACFR) grants it official status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For legal research and authoritative text rely on the official PDF on govinfo.gov; verify contents against the final official edition of the Federal Register. Only official editions provide legal notice and judicial notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal authority for publication
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice is published pursuant to 14 CFR 11.85.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice cites its statutory/regulatory authority for publication (14 CFR 11.85); petitions and related notices will reference the controlling procedural regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elements shown in the petition summary
rubrics_metrics.description: The petition summary displays key fields: Docket No.; Petitioner; Section of 14 CFR Affected; Description of Relief Sought.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shown: Docket No.: FAA-2022-0841; Petitioner: The Marvin Companies; Section affected: § 61.57(b); Description of Relief Sought: exemption to allow BE-1900D to operate with a two-pilot flight crew while the pilot in command does not meet night takeoff and landing experience requirements within the last 90 days. Use these fields to locate and understand the substance of the petition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulations.gov metadata caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: FederalRegister.gov retrieves relevant information about this document from Regulations.gov to provide users with additional context. This information is not part of the official Federal Register document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextual/enhanced content shown on FederalRegister.gov (e.g., comment counts, links to Regulations.gov) is informative but not part of the official FR text; always consult the official FR PDF or govinfo.gov for legally operative content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commenting status displayed on the page
rubrics_metrics.description: Public Comments: Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details. 1 comment has been received at Regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page displays current commenting status and the number of comments received; users should check the DATES section and Regulations.gov for up-to-date comment acceptance status and to review submitted comments.
